verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents maintained integrations with RAG or agent frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. The MCP server and the Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI tooling cover connecting coding agents, which is a separate story and earns no credit here. The axis clearly applies to a vector database, so absence of evidence is none.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations
